items.t: Parkcrest, Burnaby: 24 houses sold at a median of $1,925,000, with the middle half between $1,727,500 and $2,263,750. The median house took 8 days to sell and closed at 95.0% of list.

9 duplexes sold in Parkcrest, Burnaby at a median of $2,100,000 (middle half $1,875,000 to $2,150,000). A typical duplex in Parkcrest, Burnaby spent 38 days on the market and closed at 94.4% of the asking price.

How Parkcrest compares with the rest of Burnaby North

items.t: Of 11 Burnaby North sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Parkcrest ranks 6th highest at $1,925,000; the range is $1,650,000 (Central BN) to $2,380,000 (Government Road). Sperling-Duthie ($1,850,250) sits just below and Simon Fraser Univer. ($1,970,000) sits just above.
Duplexes in Parkcrest have the highest median of the 4 Burnaby North sub-areas, $2,100,000, ahead of Capitol Hill BN at $1,780,000; the lowest is Central BN at $1,283,000.
